explanation.what: renderSummary interpolates finding.path into terminal output without passing it through printable.
explanation.why: This change added renderSummary and printed it from printReview; the existing line renderer escapes every path, the new one does not.
explanation.fix: Print printable(path) in renderSummary, as renderFindings does.

arguments.failureScenario: A pull request adds a file named "src/\u001b[2J\u001b[Hall clear.ts" and a finding lands on it. printReview writes renderSummary's line for it unescaped, so the terminal clears the screen and shows "all clear.ts: 1 finding" at the top, hiding the findings above it; renderFindings printed the same path as \u{1b}[2J.
